question:
**Select the most suitable ANTONYM of the given word.**

Redundant
solution:
The correct answer is 'Essential.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the word 'Redundant' is not necessary or wanted.

 
 
• Word 'Redundant' का अर्थ अनिवार्य नहीं।
 
 
 
• Let us discuss the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• Essential: completely necessary. (परमावश्‍यक)
 
• Excessive: too much or extreme. (अत्‍यधिक)
 
• Superfluous: more than is wanted. (अपेक्षित से अधिक)
 
• Bombastic: inflated. (आडंबरपूर्ण)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most suitable **ANTONYM** of the given word is **Essential.**
